args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: all regions now on v2.3.0 with status rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Rollback verified — all regions now report v2.3.0 with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback, and that root cause of the v2.3.1 regression is under investigation. The on-call engineer was paged.
